title: K-FIELD: CMB-PUMPED ARMATURE ANALYSIS
subtitle: Diametric Coil Pairs, Rotating Phase Harmonics, Electrical Frequency, and Staged Tap Sequence

coordinate_conventions.cell3_scale: native Cell3 units, separate from route radius
coordinate_conventions.rotation_axis: Earth-CMB unit vector from antapex to apex

closed_route.construction: two trimmed great-circle meridians plus symmetric sinusoidal-curvature tangent-plane bridges mapped by the unit-sphere exponential map
closed_route.continuity: C3 endpoint continuity: position, tangent, curvature/force, and jerk are continuous; geodesic curvature and its arc-length derivative are zero at every interface

base_cumulative_hysteresis.definition: H(s)=C_F(s)-C_R(s) at equal traveled distance from the common start

diametric_pair_rules.same_polarity_connection: sum; reinforces even spatial harmonics and cancels odd harmonics
diametric_pair_rules.opposite_polarity_connection: difference; cancels even spatial harmonics and isolates odd harmonics

staged_ensemble.pair_channel: S_j(t)=A_pair cos(2 omega_m t + 2 pi j/P + delta_2 + beta)
staged_ensemble.simultaneous_equal_sum: zero principal fundamental for P>1; use staged commutation, rectification, or polyphase processing

interpretation_boundary.geometrically_determined: phase, harmonic content, frequency ratios, pair parity, and tap order
interpretation_boundary.requires_constitutive_device_law: absolute voltage, current, torque, power, optimal commutation lead angle, and energy conversion efficiency
